purpose: Stable trace shape for comparing baseline/adaptive extension runs without claiming semantic quality, token savings, or learnability.

field_rules.scenario_id: Stable id from the TOKEN-01 scenario pack.
field_rules.pair_id: Stable baseline/adaptive pair id from the TOKEN-01 scenario pack.
field_rules.host_name: Claude, Cursor, Codex, or another host only when the scenario pack adds it.
field_rules.method: The extension API method under test.
field_rules.debug_enabled: Must match inside a baseline/adaptive comparison pair.
field_rules.prompt_hash: sha256 hash of the redacted prompt text; raw prompt is not stored here.
field_rules.visible_answer_hash: sha256 hash of the visible answer text; raw answer is not stored here.
field_rules.tokenizer_name: The tokenizer or accounting helper name.
field_rules.tokenizer_version: The tokenizer or accounting helper version.
field_rules.tokenizer_accounting_type: Allowed values for this phase: heuristic. Future exact tokenizers must not be mixed with heuristic traces in one comparison pair.
field_rules.token_count_input: Non-negative integer produced by the named tokenizer/accounting helper.
field_rules.token_count_output: Non-negative integer produced by the named tokenizer/accounting helper.
field_rules.quality_score: Null in TOKEN-02; future quality phases may fill it with an approved rubric.
field_rules.quality_regression: Null in TOKEN-02; future quality phases may fill it with an approved rubric.
field_rules.isolation_mode: Records whether run was baseline/adaptive and isolated from local training mutation.
field_rules.artifact_refs: References to persisted traces/logs, not raw private text.
field_rules.contains_raw_private_content: Must be false for trace artifacts committed to the repo.

pairing_rules: Baseline/adaptive traces must share scenario_id, pair_id, host_name, method, debug_enabled, prompt_hash, tokenizer_name, tokenizer_version, and tokenizer_accounting_type.
Token delta alone cannot pass quality.
Heuristic and exact token accounting must never be mixed in one comparison pair.
This schema is accounting evidence only; it is not semantic-quality, DPO, training, checkpoint, or learnability evidence.
